label: Move the construction suite from the quotes module to construction

execute.description: Negocios que pasan a la suite de construcción: constructoras, carpinterías y cualquier negocio que ya tenga obras (no pierde acceso a sus datos).
execute.sql: INSERT INTO "public"."TenantModule" ("id", "tenantId", "moduleName", "active", "createdAt", "updatedAt") SELECT gen_random_uuid()::text, tm."tenantId", 'construction', tm."active", now(), now() FROM "public"."TenantModule" tm JOIN "public"."Tenant" t ON t."id" = tm."tenantId" WHERE tm."moduleName" = 'quotes' AND (t."vertical" IN ('construction', 'carpentry') OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "public"."Project" p WHERE p."tenantId" = tm."tenantId")) ON CONFLICT ("tenantId", "moduleName") DO NOTHING

execute.description: paso 2 de la separación de construcción
execute.sql: UPDATE "public"."TenantModule" SET "active" = false, "updatedAt" = now() WHERE "moduleName" = 'quotes' AND "active"

execute.description: paso 3 de la separación de construcción
execute.sql: UPDATE "public"."Tenant" t SET "contractedModules" = array_replace(t."contractedModules", 'quotes', 'construction') WHERE 'quotes' = ANY(t."contractedModules") AND (t."vertical" IN ('construction', 'carpentry') OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "public"."Project" p WHERE p."tenantId" = t."id"))

execute.description: paso 4 de la separación de construcción
Catálogo: la suite hereda precio, inclusión y orden de "quotes", y "quotes" queda planeado (la cotización genérica llega con el documento comercial).
execute.sql: INSERT INTO "public"."ModuleSetting" ("module", "label", "description", "priceUsdCents", "status", "included", "order", "updatedAt") SELECT 'construction', 'Obras y presupuestos', 'Obras, presupuestos y catálogo APU.', "priceUsdCents", 'READY', "included", "order", now() FROM "public"."ModuleSetting" WHERE "module" = 'quotes' ON CONFLICT ("module") DO NOTHING

execute.description: paso 6 de la separación de construcción
execute.sql: UPDATE "public"."ModuleSetting" SET "status" = 'PLANNED', "label" = 'Cotizaciones', "description" = 'Cotizaciones comerciales con tu catálogo (próximamente).', "updatedAt" = now() WHERE "module" = 'quotes'

execute.description: paso 7 de la separación de construcción
execute.sql: UPDATE "public"."VerticalSetting" SET "modules" = array_replace("modules", 'quotes', 'construction'), "recommended" = array_replace("recommended", 'quotes', 'construction'), "updatedAt" = now() WHERE "vertical" IN ('construction', 'carpentry')

execute.description: paso 8 de la separación de construcción
execute.sql: UPDATE "public"."VerticalSetting" SET "modules" = array_remove("modules", 'quotes'), "recommended" = array_remove("recommended", 'quotes'), "updatedAt" = now() WHERE "vertical" NOT IN ('construction', 'carpentry') AND ('quotes' = ANY("modules") OR 'quotes' = ANY("recommended"))

execute.description: paso 9 de la separación de construcción

postcheck.description: verify no tenant keeps the quotes module active
postcheck.sql: SELECT NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "public"."TenantModule" WHERE "moduleName" = 'quotes' AND "active") AS "result"
